'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]]
***[[Twelve-Day War]] ([[List of airstrikes during the Iran–Israel War|list of airstrikes]])
****The death toll from [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] [[airstrike]]s on [[Iran]] rises to at least 220 people, including 70 women and children. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/6/15/updates-death-toll-grows-as-iran-and-israel-continue-to-trade-attacks (Al Jazeera)]
****[[Israel]] strikes buildings in [[Tehran]] belonging to the [[Islamic Republic of Iran Broadcasting]], Iran's [[State media|state-owned media]] company, knocking it temporarily off-air for an hour before later returning. Three employees are killed and several others are injured. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/6/17/live-israel-iran-trade-attacks-trump-orders-residents-of-tehran-to-flee?update=3780528 (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2025/06/iran-state-tv-briefly-knocked-air-strike-after-missiles-kill-11-israel (Al-Monitor)] [https://www.wsj.com/livecoverage/israel-iran-attack-news/card/israel-bombs-iran-state-media-buildings-in-tehran-SMnTroA3jJGJpKjvdGWX (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
****Iran says Israel struck a [[hospital]] in [[Kermanshah]] in [[western Iran]]. Video footage published by local platforms showed bloodstains, indicating casualties from the strike. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/6/16/little-sign-of-restraint-as-israel-and-iran-continue-to-swap-deadly-strikes (Al Jazeera)]
****Israeli jets strike 120 [[surface-to-surface missile]] systems in [[central Iran]] and ten [[command and control]] centres belonging to the [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps|IRGC]]'s [[Quds Force]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-iran-missile-attacks-nuclear-news-06-16-2025-c98074e62ce5afd4c3f6d33edaffa069 (AP)]
****Israeli [[drone warfare|drones strike]] two [[Islamic Republic of Iran Air Force|Iranian Air Force]]  [[Grumman F-14 Tomcat|F-14 Tomcat]]s stationed at [[Imam Khomeini International Airport]]. Combat footage released by the IDF confirm both were destroyed. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-destroyed-two-iranian-f-14-fighter-jets-in-attack-on-tehran-airport/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
****An [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Aerospace Force|Iranian]] [[ballistic missile]] barrage kills eight people and injures 287 others in [[Central District (Israel)|central Israel]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/8-killed-nearly-300-injured-as-iranian-ballistic-missiles-strike-central-israel-haifa/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/israel-iran-battle-escalates-will-be-high-agenda-world-leaders-meet-2025-06-16/ (Reuters)]
****[[Iran]]'s [[Islamic Consultative Assembly|parliament]] prepares a bill to exit the international nuclear [[Non-Proliferation Treaty]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-foreign-ministry-says-parliament-is-preparing-bill-leave-npt-2025-06-16/ (Reuters)]
****Israel announces it has taken "full aerial operational control" of the [[airspace]] over [[Tehran]] and [[western Iran]] after destroying much of the country's [[Anti-aircraft warfare|air defence]] network giving the [[Israeli Air Force]] near complete [[air supremacy]] over [[Islamic Republic of Iran Armed Forces|Iranian forces]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c2kqkd03xn5t (BBC News)]
***[[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] [[United States Senate|senator]] [[Tim Kaine]] of [[Virginia]] introduces legislation to prevent [[U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] from using military force against Iran without [[United States Congress|Congress]]'s authorization. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-senator-moves-limit-trumps-war-powers-iran-mideast-conflict-escalates-2025-06-16/ (Reuters)] [https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/senate-joint-resolution/59 (US Congress)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Kincora Boys' Home|Kincora Boys' Home scandal]]
**Gary Hoy, a survivor of child sexual abuse at Kincora, resolves a legal action against the [[Police Service of Northern Ireland]] and [[Home Secretary]] with an undisclosed agreement. The legal action alleged that [[paedophile]] housemaster [[William McGrath]] was allowed to target children to gather information about the far-right paramilitary organization [[Tara (Northern Ireland)|Tara]]. [https://www.rte.ie/news/courts/2025/0616/1518712-kincora-boys-home/ (RTÉ)].
*[[Royal Thai Police|Thai police]] raid a house in [[Samut Prakan province]], [[Thailand]], and arrest 13 foreigners, mostly [[Australians]] and [[British people|British]] people, for running a [[fraud]]ulent [[electronic trading platform]] that has stolen over [[Australian dollar|AU$]]1.9 million (US$1.2 million). [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-australia-investment-scam-fraud-502276cd2888240c71e5aa1aa647e9c1 (AP)]
